player_prompt.intro:
Nang Countdown numbers game kaw na ai!
Goal: Htawng shi kaw +, -, *, / kaw na target kaw tsang ai.
Hkawhkam tsang kaba: [i j op] i, j htawng shi, op htawng operation.
Example: [0 2 *] 0 kaw 2 kaw htawng shi kaw *.
Division kaw whole numbers kaw tsang ai.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kawng ai format ma shawng ai. [i j op] hte i,j ni index ni re hte op ni +,-,*,/ hte shawng ai.
invalid_move.invalid_indices: N jaw ai index ni. n bung hkat ra nna 0-{max_index} brawng hta nga na rai nga ai.
invalid_move.invalid_operation: N jaw ai bungli (zero hte garan nna lu la ai, n hkum sumhpa re ai)

outcome.win: Hpang ga de! Hpang hku nna shang shang ai: {target}
outcome.no_moves: Hkum tsang kaba ai. Hkum tsang shi: {best_value} (target: {target})
outcome.turn_limit: Kawng ai gaw shawng ai ma ai. Shawng e taw ai hte lachyum ai: {best_value} (target: {target})
